metadata.title: Real case structures for Part I

structures.manager_question: Which counties are demographically or politically different right now?
structures.best_visual: sorted bar, scatterplot, box plot, map
structures.limitation: No time dimension, so it cannot show change.

structures.grain: one state value per month after reshaping
structures.manager_question: When did state home values rise, fall, and recover?
structures.limitation: A single national line can hide state heterogeneity.

structures.manager_question: Do stores, regions, and seasons move differently over time?
structures.best_visual: small multiples, panel summary, fixed-effect preview
structures.limitation: Store coverage changes, so coverage notes belong near charts.

structures.best_visual: map, tile map, geo small multiples
structures.limitation: Mapping is useful only when location changes action.
